causal_observation_rules: G11 stale ciphertext must come from an actual SAF export in this run. Advance counters only through ordinary CredentialManager operations and independent RP verification; never edit a phone or RP counter to manufacture rejection.
Each negative case needs fresh provider eligibility and a current real CredentialManager request or documented platform refusal; unchanged RP state alone is insufficient.
Record eligibility/ticket freshness and operation timing; do not count natural five-minute index or three-minute ticket expiry as wrong-target/cancel proof.
Use actual RP option-request progression to demonstrate a fresh request where the fixture obtains options, and compare accepted events/key/counter separately from option allocation.
G01 and G10 require wrong_key_or_corrupt from the attempted wrong-password operation, not a missing-selection refusal.
G08 requires choose_backup_destination_first after cancelling a new picker and an unchanged original destination digest.
G09 requires choose_encrypted_vault_first after cancelling/failing a new picker, with no reactivation of the old staged input.
G11 requires a new independent RP verification_rejected event with counter_rollback_or_replay, not merely a generic fixture error.
A fresh native store on this same physical phone is an app-data reset/restore observation; do not claim a second physical passkey device or a measured private-directory inode.
A separately reviewed reset helper may be bound before its first case while earlier non-destructive cases run; pending helper work cannot pass or erase a case.

Before treating wrong-certificate or wrong-package cases as identity refusals, confirm the installed fixed fixture variant carries the normal allowed-provider permission; retain exact provider filtering and never grant permissions ad hoc.

G07 uses the original request and unlock time origins across both Back actions. A local observation return is rejected if it arrives after its original observation deadline, even when its content looks successful.
G07 uses the final verified RP snapshot and its observed monotonic time for the pass gate; there is no second unvalidated RP fetch that can extend the 180/300-second windows.

G08 and G10 use separate fresh URI selections. No product Write, including a failed Write, occurs between selection and the tested action. The unconsumed condition is a precondition only: the negative G10 Write itself consumes the URI.

For G08/G10 only, after the picker creates the exact initially absent empty target, QA may perform one empty-file compare followed by one copy of the fixed 615-byte synthetic seed ciphertext. Record that operation as fixture preparation, never as a product backup export. Unknown writes are not automatically repeated; all files and media rows remain subject to exact owned cleanup.

input_admission.binding: Freeze and independently review the separate component manifest with helper and runner hashes before first phone input. The helper pins this public profile and build receipt.
input_admission.method: ordinary real password EditText; clear with keyboard Ctrl+A/Delete and freshly recheck exact foreground, focus, unique password field and fixed standard hint before private synthetic master read

report_rules: Keep every case; report expected, executed, passed, failed, blocked and missing separately.
A successful ADB phase, installation, host test or signature-only unit test does not pass a CredentialManager behavior.
Retain initial failures and later candidate attempts; do not pool runtime hashes into one qualification.
Fresh-store restore on this one phone is not physical cross-device migration or generic passkey portability.
Latest-backup recovery is supported only when its counter has not been superseded at the strict RP.
Do not pool r4, the failed first r5 build, r5b, r6, r7 or different r8 artifacts into one result.
Preserve setup failures separately from all eighteen case states; phase success does not pass a case.
M07 passes only after settings, exact package absence, owned reverse mapping and tracked synthetic documents are all checked.
All eighteen cases execute anew in one fresh r9 run using the exact same r8-built product artifact combination. No earlier case result is inherited.
Original r8 16/18 and its three separate one-case supplements remain immutable independent records; their union is never reported as an r9 result.

Persist each new Runtime request/launch/terminal independently. Record the actual M05 reset and restore launch audit_recorded flags, including any false or unavailable response, without inheriting or erasing the earlier r8 audit gap.
Positive controls are prerequisites inside their case, not additional denominator cases. Successful UI phases never pass a case by themselves.
